=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/drift_audit.sh:404-424 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Each batched GraphQL fragment appends a trailing `\t}` that closes the surrounding `repository(...)` block too early, so multi-issue queries become syntactically invalid.
  WHY: GitHub rejects the malformed query, `_gh_json` falls back to `{}`, and `_fetch_latest_merged_linked_prs` returns no linked PRs, leaving resolved clusters open.
- scripts/drift_audit.sh:483-487 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `_pattern_matches_patch` runs anchored fingerprint regexes against raw unified-diff hunks that still carry `+`/`-`/space prefixes, so anchored patterns never match.
  WHY: PR-diff rechecks misclassify fixed drift as unresolved and keep tracker issues open.
- scripts/drift_audit.sh:65-72 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `_run_gh` decodes subprocess output with `encoding="utf-8"` but no `errors=` override, so malformed log bytes can raise `UnicodeDecodeError`.
  WHY: A single non-UTF-8 byte in a fetched run log can crash the audit before marker parsing and block tracker updates.
- scripts/drift_audit.sh:570-620 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: When a resolved cluster has an existing tracker issue but `_close_issue` fails, the failure is effectively silent and the same cluster is re-detected on later runs.
  WHY: Repeated close attempts accumulate while the tracker issue stays open, violating the one-tracker-per-cluster behavior.
- scripts/drift_audit.sh:695-705 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: When `_recheck_cluster` returns `resolved=True`, a failed `_close_issue` only logs a warning and does not create any durable state for that resolution path.
  WHY: A transient API blip leaves the tracker issue open and the same cluster can be retried on later runs until manually closed.
- .github/workflows/drift-audit.yml:18-35 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The scheduled drift-audit job has no explicit `timeout-minutes`.
  WHY: A hung `gh run view --log` or stalled API call can consume the default 6-hour runner limit and block subsequent cron runs because `cancel-in-progress: false`.
- scripts/drift_audit.sh:280-340 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The audit re-downloads and re-parses logs for every run in the 24h window even when those runs were already processed.
  WHY: Without run-id caching on ai-memory, the job wastes GitHub API quota and wall-clock time on repeated log fetches.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:47 and 87 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The `ai:resolver-escalated` label metadata can drift between the helper maps and the label contract, leaving consumer forks with out-of-sync fixtures and fallback metadata on new label creation.
  WHY: Label repair logic and contract tests then see a mismatch, so fallback color/description is used on new label creation.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/ci.yml, .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml, or .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: `tests/test_drift_audit_job.py` and `tests/test_fingerprint_quarantine.py` exist, but grepping ci.yml, mark-stable.yml, and test-and-mark-stable.yml finds no references, so the tests are not executed in CI.
- requirement: "Keep GitHub API usage batched (run-list first, then per-run log fetches; no per-fingerprint API loop)" and "cache by run-id on ai-memory"
  expected_change_site: scripts/drift_audit.sh
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: The script fetches run-lists then per-run logs but never writes run-ids to ai-memory, never checks a cache, and has no `_persist_seen_runs` or equivalent; every daily invocation re-downloads the same logs.
- requirement: "Build on the Phase 4A quarantine model instead of inventing a second persistence format"
  expected_change_site: scripts/ai_memory.py, scripts/ai_memory_lib.py, and verify_integration_fingerprints.py import sites
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: `tests/test_fingerprint_quarantine.py` was rewritten to stub verifier-side `_ai_memory_load_quarantine_list` / `_ai_memory_persist_quarantine_list` instead of exercising the real `get_fingerprint_quarantine` / `put_fingerprint_quarantine` round-trip; the original temp-memory end-to-end coverage was removed.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- File: scripts/drift_audit.sh
  Line or code reference: Line 421 (the `\t}` line at the end of the fragment.append block inside `_fetch_latest_merged_linked_prs`)
  Problem: Each batched GraphQL fragment ends with `\t}`; the fragment already closes the `issue(...)` block with `\t\t}` at line 420, so the trailing `\t}` is an extra closing brace that prematurely closes `repository(...)`.
  Why it fails at runtime: For multi-issue batches the query becomes syntactically invalid, GitHub GraphQL returns a parse error, `_gh_json` falls back to `default={}`, and `_fetch_latest_merged_linked_prs` returns an empty dict.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: scripts/drift_audit.sh
  Line or code reference: Lines 483-487 (`_pattern_matches_patch` function)
  Problem: `re.search(pattern, patch, re.MULTILINE)` runs the fingerprint regex directly against unified diff hunk text, and anchored patterns like `^def reconcile_labels` or `EXPECTED_LINE$` can never match because of diff prefixes.
  Why it fails at runtime: PR-diff rechecks incorrectly conclude the drift is unresolved even when the merged PR contains the expected code.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- File: scripts/drift_audit.sh
  Line or code reference: Lines 65-72 (`_run_gh` function, `subprocess.run` call)
  Problem: `subprocess.run` is called with `text=True, encoding="utf-8"` but no `errors=` parameter, so a single non-decodable byte can raise `UnicodeDecodeError`.
  Why it fails at runtime: If any recent log contains non-UTF-8 bytes, the script terminates before any markers are processed.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- File: scripts/drift_audit.sh
  Line or code reference: Lines 695-705 (main loop, resolved-cluster close section)
  Problem: When `_recheck_cluster` returns `resolved=True` and `_close_issue` fails, the script only increments `closed` on success and logs a warning on failure.
  Why it fails at runtime: The cluster is not durably marked as resolved, so the same close attempt repeats on later runs until manually fixed.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- File: .github/workflows/drift-audit.yml
  Line or code reference: Line 23 (the `drift-audit` job definition)
  Problem: The `drift-audit` job has no `timeout-minutes` set.
  Why it fails at runtime: A hung job can run until the default 6-hour GitHub Actions runner timeout and block the concurrency slot.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- File: scripts/drift_audit.sh
  Line or code reference: Lines 330-340 (main loop, `_fetch_run_log` calls)
  Problem: Each daily invocation calls `_fetch_run_log` for every run in the 24-hour lookback window, including runs already fetched and found to contain zero markers.
  Why it fails at runtime: The script re-downloads and re-parses logs that were already processed, wasting GitHub API quota and time.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- Requirement: "add focused tests for marker parsing, dedup, and issue-upsert behavior"
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/ci.yml, .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml, or .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml
  Evidence of absence: `tests/test_drift_audit_job.py` and `tests/test_fingerprint_quarantine.py` exist on disk and appear in both PR_CHANGED_FILES and LAST_RUN_CHANGED_FILES, but neither file is listed in any CI workflow test allowlist.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
